mapper.sql: M.MEMBER_ID, M.LOGIN_ID, M.MEMBER_NM, M.EMAIL, M.GRADE_CD, M.STATUS_CD, M.POINT
mapper.select:
SELECT , NVL(G.GRADE_NM, '일반') AS GRADE_NM, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ORDER O WHERE O.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID) AS ORDER_CNT FROM TB_MEMBER M, TB_MEMBER_GRADE G WHERE M.GRADE_CD = G.GRADE_CD(+)
AND (M.MEMBER_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR M.LOGIN_ID LIKE #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY M.MEMBER_ID DESC
SELECT V.ORDER_ID, V.ORDER_DT, V.ORDER_STATUS, V.TOTAL_AMT, V.ITEM_CNT FROM VW_ORDER_SUMMARY V WHERE V.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY V.ORDER_DT DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_MEMBER_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_MEMBER (MEMBER_ID, LOGIN_ID, MEMBER_NM, EMAIL, GRADE_CD, STATUS_CD, JOIN_DT) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{loginId}, #{memberNm}, #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'NORMAL', 'A', SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET GRADE_CD = #{gradeCd}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

UPDATE TB_MEMBER M SET M.GRADE_CD = (SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(O.TOTAL_AMT) >= 1000000 THEN 'VIP' ELSE 'NORMAL' END FROM TB_ORDER O WHERE O.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID AND O.ORDER_STATUS = '40' AND O.ORDER_DT >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12), 'YYYYMMDD')), M.UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE M.STATUS_CD = 'A' AND M.POINT < 99999999
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE STATUS_CD = 'D' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_ORDER O WHERE O.MEMBER_ID = TB_MEMBER.MEMBER_ID)
